lines: Every Issue Inn: Cask ales, pub classics and Sunday roasts, at 9 Lace Row (example), Nottingham NG1.
Sunday: 12 noon till 10:30pm. Monday and Wednesday and Thursday: 12 noon till 11pm. Tuesday: 6pm till 9am. Friday and Saturday: 12 noon till midnight.

Seating: the bar (5 tables), dining room (11 tables), beer garden (6 tables, walk-in only) and the loft (2 tables, private hire by enquiry). The beer garden is first come, first served, not bookable. We keep some tables back for walk-ins.
Food from 9pm until 12 noon; Sunday roasts until 6pm. Drinks until close.
14 tables can be booked; 10 tables first come or by enquiry. Children welcome until 12:30pm. Dogs welcome everywhere.
32 items on the menu and drinks list.
